column1: # The accent run's pairs for spike K of the 0.8.0 plan, read by scripts/measure_kde_accent.sh
# (a bare name is the installed scheme file /usr/share/color-schemes/<name>.colors): the three
# schemes breeze installs, each with no accent and two fixed accents, #e5a50a (a yellow: low
# contrast on a light background, so the link colour is darkened) and #5e2ca5 (a violet: low
# contrast on a dark one, so it is lightened). BreezeClassic is the one installed scheme with the
# accent-coloured title bar option (accentActiveTitlebar=true), and it has no Colors:Header
# group. The last two pairs check that the scheme applied first leaves nothing behind:
# BreezeLight after BreezeClassic instead of BreezeDark, and BreezeClassic applied to a fresh
# configuration with no scheme before it.
